messages:
ops-lead: Starting a blue/green traffic shuffle for /v1/chat. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: migrate traffic to green (v2026.3.21) using micro-steps: 4% -> 12% -> 28% -> drain green warm -> 56% -> 100%. Holds: 3m after 12%, 10m after 28% and 56%. Abort if 5xx rate >0.7% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency >+250ms over baseline. Pinning plan: temporarily pin to blue (v2026.02) if rollback required. @nina you'll run the drain script at 28% step.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kickoff accepted. release=release-2026-03-21-bluegreen job=bg-3389. I'll post confirmations and diffs.

nina: Got it. Ill be standing by for the 28% go.

omar: Quick prod note: edge pool eu-west1 has a few older kubelet nodes still on 1.22. Watch pod reschedules.

lee: Dash panels linked: https://grafana.company/d/abcd/chat-api-overview baseline p95=85ms, error=0.09%. Also watch "backend timeouts" and "kube-shed-pods".

ops-lead: Running first step -> 4% now.

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /v1/chat --version green --weight 4% -> OK

kyra: Telemetry: p95 -> 92ms, errors unchanged. small noise on aws egress but within thresholds.

ops-lead: Moving to 12% in 2m.

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /v1/chat --version green --weight 12% -> OK

lee: 12% hold: p95 100ms, error 0.12%. db pool usage up 6%. all green.

ops-lead: Proceed to 28%. @nina get ready to cordon.

(deploy-bot posts weight change)

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /v1/chat --version green --weight 28% -> OK

nina: Starting edge drain for blue nodes labeled: `kubectl -n front label node rack-12 cordon=draining && kubectl -n front drain rack-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ops-lead: Observability check in 30s.

lee: Whoa, p95 jumped to 320ms across multiple regions. error rate climbed to 1.2% (3m). Backend timeout traces point to a new auth client (authx v2) used by green that sometimes retires connections.

omar: Confirmed in logs: authx v2 failing TLS handshakes with some older infra proxies -> exceptions and retries. 503s from green pods only.

ops-lead: Abort criteria hit. Rolling back to 12% and pin to blue. 

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /v1/chat --version green --weight 12% -> OK

deploy-bot: routerctl: pin --route /v1/chat --version blue --reason "auto-rollback-authx-tls-failures" -> OK

nina: Stopping drains, uncordoning rack-12 -> `kubectl uncordon rack-12`

kyra: Metrics returning: p95 110ms, errors back to 0.14%.

ops-lead: Post-action notes: - Do not unpin yet; keep blue pinned until authx fix is rolled. - Add canary config to exclude old infra proxies from green for next attempt. - Add an e2e check for TLS compatibility in the preflight job. I'll open an incident and a follow-up release-note item.

lee: I'll open a small revert-hotfix in authx with a compatibility toggle, target 10% canary tomorrow.

omar: Also schedule a node upgrade pass for eu-west1 to remove old kubelet 1.22 nodes.

ops-lead: Thanks all. Closing this thread 44d We'll re-run once authx and node upgrades are done.

deploy-bot: job bg-3389 status=aborted_by_op. Notes posted to release-log: https://logs.company/releases/bg-3389

kyra: Added a short note to the runbook: "If TLS handshakes fail on green only, rollback and pin blue, do not retry until authx compatibility is verified."

ops-lead: Good catch everyone.
